_capture: Captured verbatim from jsp1440/orchid-calyx-backend origin/main 089c47ee34f4 (#1639; git archive export) via FastAPI TestClient on app.main, GET /api/interactions/discovery. No auth: the route is public. default_runtime_no_database_url: DATABASE_URL unset, default semantic-index runtime -- the backend serves an empty in-memory index as status ok, count 0, and since #1639 labels it index_state 'memory_unprovisioned' with index_note. empty: fresh activated MemoryIndexRepository (as in tests/test_interaction_discovery_routes.py::_fresh_repository), nothing ingested. ok / ok_truncated: fresh MemoryIndexRepository, then the backend's OWN TEST FIXTURE records from tests/test_interaction_discovery_routes.py::_ingest_sample (the pollinatedBy record and the hasHost override used by test_discover_interactions_filters_by_category) ingested through the real ingest_globi_interactions_for_canonical_dataset(dataset_version='globi-2026-08') path. empty_durable_test_double / ok_durable_test_double: same, but the runtime is the backend test's _FakeDurableRepository (a MemoryIndexRepository exposing atomic/refresh_for_read) with a fake postgresql URL, exactly as tests/test_interaction_discovery_routes.py::_durable_repository -- a TEST DOUBLE, not a real durable database; it pins the index_state 'durable' SHAPE only. These taxa/citations are backend TEST FIXTURE values ('Example study 2020', 'GloBI dataset v1'), NOT real scientific interaction evidence; they pin the response SHAPE only. invalid_category: category=not-a-real-category. Bodies unmodified. unreadable_count is not present: it is added by an unmerged backend follow-up, so no captured body carries it. legacy_c346a7219: the previous capture, kept verbatim, from origin/main c346a7219d6f (before #1639, no index_state) -- it pins the older-backend shape.
